scope: Batch 10 extraction from the untagged 2011 'A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia' features (official Wizards). PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; targeted, not exhaustive; not owner approved.

claims.subject: mirrodin

quotes.quote: The plane of which we speak was once named Argentum. Then it became known as Mirrodin.

claims.summary: The plane was once named Argentum, then Mirrodin, and now bears a third name (New Phyrexia).

claims.subject: new_phyrexia

quotes.quote: But radical change has visited this world again, and now it bears a third name.

claims.summary: Mirrodin was remade and renamed New Phyrexia, its third name.
claims.limitation: The quote does not spell the name; the guide's title gives it.

claims.subject: steel_thanes

quotes.quote: Yet a usurper sits upon the throne: Karn.
To the thanes, this man of dumb silver cannot be the real Father of Machines.

claims.summary: The thanes see Karn as a usurper on the throne, not the real Father of Machines.

quotes.quote: A native Phyrexian beast known as Vorinclex rules the Tangle

claims.subject: glissa

quotes.quote: His closest advisor is Glissa, formerly a Viridian elf, who was compleated during the years that Phyrexia lurked in the core.

claims.summary: Glissa, formerly a Viridian elf compleated while Phyrexia lurked in Mirrodin's core, is Vorinclex's closest advisor.

claims.subject: elesh_norn

quotes.quote: The Grand Cenobite Elesh Norn, the Orthodoxy's highest-ranking Praetor, commands and guides this faction of Phyrexia

claims.summary: Elesh Norn, the Grand Cenobite, commands the Machine Orthodoxy (New Phyrexia, 2011).

claims.subject: apostles_of_karn

quotes.quote: Another sect of the Machine Orthodoxy is the Apostles of Karn

claims.summary: The Apostles of Karn are a sect of the Machine Orthodoxy.

claims.subject: apostles_of_karn

quotes.quote: has adopted the powerful silver golem Karn as their chosen leader

claims.summary: The Apostles of Karn chose Karn as Phyrexia's leader.

claims.subject: yawgmoth

quotes.quote: Although the Phyrexian civilization that has grown on Mirrodin was not the same as that led by Yawgmoth

claims.summary: Yawgmoth led the earlier Phyrexian civilization, in the past era before New Phyrexia.
claims.limitation: The quote contrasts New Phyrexia with the former Phyrexia led by Yawgmoth; object is the civilization, not the plane.

claims.subject: jin_gitaxias

quotes.quote: Jin-Gitaxias dwells within the now fully Phyrexianized Lumengrid

claims.summary: Jin-Gitaxias dwells in the Phyrexianized Lumengrid, his laboratory.

claims.subject: urabrask

quotes.quote: The vast majority of red-aligned Phyrexians dwell in the so-called Furnace Layer

claims.summary: The Furnace Layer is home to most red-aligned Phyrexians, the faction of Urabrask the Hidden.
claims.limitation: Urabrask's leadership is implied by the guide's framing, not stated in this sentence.

remaining: Targeted. The 'a-planeswalkers-guide-to-new-phyrexia' landing page is recorded as reviewed (index).
